facts.fact: The document says Madagascar still relies on legislation adopted in 2014, which the minister's review considers inadequate; the document gives no further date, so the year is the adoption year.

The minister said at the 22-23 June 2026 symposium that the review launched in December 2025 is nearing completion and a new regulatory framework with incident definitions and critical-infrastructure criteria will be published shortly; no bill is named.
